top_offers.title: Founding FullStack Engineer
top_offers.why: VC-backed startup building browser-native AI agents for financial advisory, a genuine founding role with zero-to-one scope and strong AI-agent exposure that echoes the Alaya build-from-scratch story. The catch is it reads as SF-onsite, which cuts hard against a Geneva base and is the main reason this lands just under a B despite the role-impact and mission fit.

top_offers.title: Founding CTO / Head of Engineering
top_offers.why: Founding CTO scope at an early-stage physical-AI startup for skilled trades, remote-eligible which helps, but the stack leans robotics/physical-AI rather than the TypeScript/Node/AI-platform mix Magino's built his career on, and $175-225k is modest for a full CTO risk profile.

top_offers.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Founding Technical Role)
top_offers.why: A rare Switzerland-based founding/co-founder-equity role at a DIY/impact-investing platform, which scores well on location and role-impact. The listed cash comp ($36-42k) looks unusually low for the Swiss market, possibly a data artifact on the aggregator, so this is worth a look but the compensation picture needs verifying directly with the company before treating it as a real offer.

note: LinkedIn cookie in /tmp/linkedin_cookie.txt returned an auth redirect loop (HTTP 302) again, so all searches ran on web sources only. Safra Sarasin, Nexthink x2, Sourcemap, Reedsy, Langfuse's two current openings, and several WeWorkRemotely/RemoteOK US-remote listings were all repeats, several of them re-discovered under different aggregator URLs than previously tracked, e.g. Jam.dev and Sourcemap and one Langfuse posting, and de-duplicated by company+title rather than URL alone).
